name: CANAL+ Telecom data center Baie-Mahault
notes: Telco data center inaugurated April 2022 in the Baie-Mahault industrial zone (Guadeloupe); facility-grade evidence from press.

name: WDH Tier III data center Baie-Mahault
notes: Tier III data center in Baie-Mahault, Guadeloupe, listed on operator official page; capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft data center campus Petit-Landau / Hombourg
notes: Microsoft mega data center on communes of Petit-Landau and Hombourg (Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération), 3 buildings, with RTE grid partnership. MRAe (Mar 2026) flagged incomplete dossier and recommended suspending permit instruction (consumption ~80% of Haut-Rhin household electricity). Unique public inquiry (autorisation environnementale + permits) opened 1 Jun 2026; M2A gave favorable opinion. Construction start planned end Q1 2027, first building in service 2030, full site 2032. Capacity not disclosed.

name: ETIX Toulouse #1 (Balma)
notes: Etix proximity/colo data center at 10 Rue des Frères Peugeot, 31130 Balma (Toulouse metro); ISO 27001/SOC 2; ~14 colo facilities in Toulouse per aggregators; capacity not disclosed.

name: Limoges enterprise data center project
developer: Unnamed Limoges-based company (data center strategy consultant Frédéric Bordes cited)
notes: France3 report: a Limoges (Haute-Vienne) company considering building its own data center for data storage security; no permit or facility evidence yet - weak/unverified lead.

name: SoberCloud solar-powered alpine datacenter (Briançon)
notes: French sovereign/sustainable cloud provider operating a solar-powered datacenter in Briançon (Hautes-Alpes); self-published operator page only - capacity and status unverified (C).

name: Green Datacenter 65 (Tarbes area)
notes: Crowdfunding (Ulule) initiative to build a data center in Hautes-Pyrénées for local digital development; no operator/permit evidence - unverified lead.

name: Global Switch Paris East & West (Clichy)
notes: Global Switch carrier-neutral campus at 7-9 Rue Petit, Clichy-Levallois (Hauts-de-Seine), between Paris financial district and La Défense; Paris East ~375,000 sq ft with 22-34 MW power (aggregator figures vary: 22 MW datacentermap, 27 MW datacenters.com, 34 MW ocolo); Paris West adjacent. Hosts Google Cloud Paris-region capacity per industry reports (LMI).

name: ETIX Montpellier #1
notes: Etix carrier-neutral colo data center at 143 Rue Emile Julien, Montpellier (Hérault); 15+ operators/ISPs on site; acquired from DataBank in 5-DC deal (Jul 2023); capacity not disclosed.

name: NDC Rennes-Roazhon data center (Noyal-sur-Vilaine)
notes: Data center at 7 Rue Alain Fournier, 35530 Noyal-sur-Vilaine (Rennes metro); French AI minister visited the site; facility-grade evidence from press/operator pages.

name: SFR data center Cesson-Sévigné
notes: SFR data center at Cesson-Sévigné (Rennes metro), fibre-optic racks photographed by France24 (Dec 2020 operational reference); telco facility.

name: UltraEdge Rennes edge hub
notes: UltraEdge edge data center hub in Rennes (Bretagne) per operator official page; capacity not disclosed.

name: Google data center campus Ozans (Etrechet / Châteauroux)
notes: Google's first owned French data center: 195 ha reserved (~EUR 58m) on ZAC d'Ozans, commune Etrechet near Châteauroux (Indre); CNDP concertation préalable decision 2026/37 (Legifrance, 1 Apr 2026) for project + electrical connection; 8-10 buildings envisaged; contractual land-sale deadline 5 Jul 2030. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Buzançais data center project
notes: Second Indre data center project announced at Buzançais, possibly before Google's; developer unnamed, no permit evidence yet.

name: Castle IT data center Larçay (Tours)
notes: IaaS hosting data center at Larçay near Tours (Indre-et-Loire, 37) per operator page; serves reseller network; capacity not disclosed.
